name: fullstack-feature
description: Design, then backend and frontend in parallel, integration tests, review, and documentation.

stages.name: Design
stages.promptTemplate:
Task: {task}

Produce a plan with two independent parts, the backend and the frontend, and define the API contract between them.

stages.name: Backend
stages.promptTemplate:
Implement the backend part of the plan for: {task}

{input:design}

stages.name: Frontend
stages.promptTemplate:
Implement the frontend part of the plan for: {task}

{input:design}

stages.name: Integration test
stages.promptTemplate:
Write and run integration tests that exercise the frontend against the backend for: {task}

Report what passed and failed.

stages.name: Review
stages.promptTemplate:
Review the whole change for: {task}

List must-fix problems first, then suggestions.

stages.name: Docs
